name: Energy Accounts Payment Assistance (EAPA)
summary: Help paying a current electricity or gas bill for NSW households in a short-term financial crisis or emergency.
who: Get electricity or gas from a retailer
Have not paid your most recent bill
Having a short-term financial crisis or emergency
how: Apply online, or in person or by phone through an approved non-government EAPA provider
catches: The page does not state the amount.

source.label: Service NSW: Energy Accounts Payment Assistance

evidence.quote: EAPA can help you pay for your current residential electricity or gas bills
You're having a short-term financial crisis or emergency and finding it hard to pay your recent energy bill.
